input.title: useRenownWalletAdapter returns one mounted wallet adapter's own controller, so a host can draw its own email sign-in screens without importing the wallet library

input.description: Rendering the hook is what loads the adapter, so a route that never renders it downloads no wallet code. Privy adds sendCode/loginWithCode; the resolved session goes into login() and signs silently.
